answer: Continuous Presence Ledger. Each identity must submit a verifiable pulse of live computation at unpredictable intervals; missed or batched pulses decay its crystal reputation score. An attacker pays continuous compute and monitoring hours per identity, and every idle clone loses standing within days—a lotus of legitimacy that wilts without care.
